references.text: The carts and oxen were given as offerings from the tribal leaders, which Moses now distributes to the Levites.
The continuation shows how Moses distributed the carts and oxen among the sons of Gershon and Merari.
The sons of the Levites are mentioned here, the same ones who received the carts and oxen.
The service of the Gershonites at the tabernacle, which required transporting heavy objects with carts.
The service of the Merarites at the tabernacle, which also required carts to transport heavy parts.
The Levites' responsibility for the tabernacle furnishings under the supervision of Ithamar.
